description:
Leidos is seeking a Software Developer with strong problem solving and analytical skills who is detail-oriented with a focus on data accuracy and reliability. We are looking for a developer with hands on experience in ETL/ELT development, data integration, and pipeline orchestration. The selected will have proven experience designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines, a strong understanding of data transformation, cleansing, validation, and migration processes and experience working with large, complex datasets across multiple source systems.

 The customer applies technical resources to accelerate the timely, reliable, and secure delivery of open source data, information, and insights. They require support to maintain and enhance an existing big data exploitation platform. The Software Developer will work within an agile team environment. Work will include creating Amazon Web Services (AWS)-based resources; writing, testing, and debugging custom application code; administering database services; and performing data cleaning, formatting, and other forms of data management. The selected developer’s responsibilities include:
 Designing, developing, and optimizing ETL pipelines and data workflows
 Integrating data from multiple internal and external systems
 Ensuring data quality, reliability, and consistency across pipelines
 Troubleshooting and resolve performance and data integrity issues
 Collaborating with engineering, analytics, and business teams to support data needs
 Documenting pipeline architecture, processes, and operational procedures
 
 The ideal candidate will meet all of the listed skills/experiences but that as this person will work within a team, the client has the ability to approve candidates who meet most of the listed skills/experiences:
 Early/mid-level (5+ ish years usual benchmark) hands-on experience in ETL/ELT development, data integration, and pipeline orchestration
 Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines
 Strong understanding of data transformation, cleansing, validation, and migration processes
 Experience working with large, complex datasets across multiple source systems
 
 As well as the Basic Qualifications: 
 Must have an active TS/SCI with Poly to be considered
 Must have a Bachelor's and at least 12 years of relatable work experience OR a Masters and at least 10 years of relatable work experience OR 16+ years of relatable work experience in lieu of degree.
 Strong expertise in ETL tools, frameworks, and best practices
 Proficiency in TypeScript, Node.js, and Python for backend and data pipeline development
 Experience developing and maintaining API integrations, batch jobs, and automated workflows
 Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases
 Familiarity with data modeling, schema design, and performance optimization
 Experience with cloud-based or on-prem data environments
 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience with Elasticsearch, including indexing, querying, and optimizing search/data
 Experience with Apache NiFi for data flow automation and orchestration
 Familiarity with streaming and event-driven architectures
 Experience with NoSQL databases, message queues, or distributed systems
 Exposure to data warehousing and analytics platforms
 
 #MSBA
 If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

September 17, 2026 
 For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.







 
 
 Pay Range: 
Pay Range $131,300.00 - $237,350.00 
 The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.
